source.title: Asia West & South Senior Delegate Announcement (October 2026)
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

We are happy to announce we have a new Senior Delegate, Sukesh Kumar, for Asia West & South.

Sukesh was selected by the WCA Board by voting among them, following Section 4 of our [Motion](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/09.2025.1%2520-%2520Senior%2520Delegates.pdf) about Senior Delegates.

<!-- break -->
We extend our support and best wishes to Sukesh in fulfilling his new responsibilities. His term as Senior Delegate starts on October 15, 2026.

Sukesh was among two applicants we had for the Senior Delegate for Asia West & South role. The candidacy documents can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1OTzhbXpOIibmd_xh6KcLXcVkl64nuCJM?usp=drive_link).

translation.title: 西亚与南亚高级代表任命公告（2026 年 10 月）
translation.content:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

我们很高兴宣布，Sukesh Kumar 将担任西亚与南亚的新任高级代表。

WCA 董事会依据[《高级代表决议》](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/09.2025.1%2520-%2520Senior%2520Delegates.pdf)第 4 节，经董事会成员投票选出 Sukesh。

我们将支持 Sukesh 履行新的职责，祝他工作顺利。他的高级代表任期自 2026 年 10 月 15 日开始。

此次西亚与南亚高级代表职位共有两名申请人，Sukesh 是其中之一。申请材料可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1OTzhbXpOIibmd_xh6KcLXcVkl64nuCJM?usp=drive_link)查看。
